info.name: HustleHub+ API - Part 2 RBAC, ownership and validation denials
info.description:
Denial cases for RBAC, ownership checks, input validation and status codes.

Run from HustleHub/api with `npm run test:rbac` after starting the API. The collection uses @hustlehub.test accounts and may need the API rate-limit counters reset after running the full-flow collection. Admin checks need --env-var adminEmail=<email> and --env-var adminPassword=<password>; never store real admin credentials in this file.

Remove test accounts with `node test-models.js --cleanup`.

item.name: 3. Wrong role (403)
item.description: Logged-in users are refused on routes their role may not use. The role is read from the database, never from the request.

item.name: Client tries to create a gig

exec: pm.test("Error message is \"Access denied: this action requires one of these roles: freelancer\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Access denied: this action requires one of these roles: freelancer"));

exec: pm.test("Error message is \"Access denied: this action requires one of these roles: freelancer\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Access denied: this action requires one of these roles: freelancer"));

request.description: Sending a role in the request changes nothing: authorizeRoles only trusts the role stored in the database.
